questions.learningObjective: Convert a non-rebuttable claim into a rebuttable one
questions.stem: How can a translator make 'this rendering feels right' rebuttable?

answer.exemplar: By adding criteria and evidence, such as reader comprehension tests or corpus parallels, so others can check and challenge it.

questions.explanation: Adding criteria and evidence makes a subjective claim testable; without them it resists rebuttal. Testability is the goal.

questions.subject: SEMINAR
questions.topic: Tone that closes a discussion

stimulus.body: A note states 'No serious translator would disagree with this rendering.'

questions.stem: What effect does this dogmatic tone have?

options.text: It closes discussion by delegitimizing dissent

questions.explanation: Dogmatic tone dismisses dissent and avoids engagement; it does not invite, clarify, or prove. Closure is the effect.
